answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in jade, verified in willow, and vertex names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. A 285 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
